name: Nose tip section
method: FDM print standing on the spigot, tip up, 0.2 mm layers, 3 perimeters, 0 % infill
dimensions: Tangent ogive sta 0–150, wall 1.2, solid tip 8; 2 mm split web + spigot 10 × 1.6 wall
tolerance: OD ±0.3; spigot fit tune on coupon
assembly: 30-min epoxy, align seam, tape jig
purpose: Aerodynamic nose, low drag at M<0.3

name: Nose base + shoulder
method: FDM print split face down; chamfered lugs/bosses need no support; 4 perimeters in shoulder
dimensions: Ogive sta 150–264 + spigot socket; shoulder ⌀63.7 × 60, wall 1.6; 3 radial M3 insert bosses @ [90, 210, 330]°; 3 lugs sta 306–318 @ [30, 150, 270]°
interface: I-01: 3× M3 radial into PL-201 @ sta 294
assembly: Heat-set inserts, then bond NC-101

name: Nose bulkhead / ballast mount
assembly: Bolt; rod nut on aft face
purpose: Closes payload bay forward; carries ballast

name: Ballast rod kit
material: A2 stainless M6 rod, nylock nuts, M6 fender washers
assembly: Stack washers as needed to hit target CG; nylock both ends

name: Payload tube
method: Cut from stock with tube-cutting jig
interface: I-01 nose, I-02 AV coupler bond
assembly: Mark holes with printed wrap-around drill guide

name: GPS / sensor tray + bracket
dimensions: 50 × 82 × 2.5 plate + 22 × 26 × 8 foot (90 overall); 2 M3 inserts @ (±7, -14); 6 M2.5 insert bosses
interface: 2× M3 × 16 from inside the AV bay through AV-303 into the foot inserts
assembly: Modules on M2.5 standoffs

name: Camera cradle
dimensions: Pocket CAM_W × CAM_H × CAM_LEN (USER: measure camera); saddle R31.9
interface: Bonded to tube wall, lens concentric with hole
assembly: Dry-fit camera, epoxy saddle

name: Lens cowl
dimensions: 40 long × 20 wide × 8 high teardrop, 15° aft-looking window
assembly: Epoxy + fillet; sand fair

name: Access hatch
method: FDM print curved panel (0.25 mm nozzle recommended: 1 mm wall)
interface: 2× M2.5 × 6 button head into PL-206 ledge inserts
assembly: Remove to reach camera button / GPS USB

name: Hatch doubler frame
dimensions: 54 × 40 saddle R31.9, 2 thick; opening 28 × 25 (6 mm ledges); 2 M2.5 insert bosses
assembly: Epoxy before cutting final opening
purpose: Restores tube stiffness at cut-out; carries the hatch

name: Avionics coupler
assembly: Bond fwd half into PL-201; aft half sanded / taped to tune separation force

name: Switch band
assembly: Bond with coupler inserted in both tubes (alignment)
purpose: Exterior band, switch and static-port access

name: Forward bulkhead
method: Laser cut or hole saw + disc-sander jig
interface: I-02; bears on coupler fwd end face
assembly: Epoxy into coupler; seal with fillet

name: Aft bulkhead
interface: I-04a recovery attachment; outer disc seats on AV-309
assembly: Slides on rods; washer + nylock nut each rod

name: Threaded rods
assembly: Loctite 243 into inserts (metal-metal only)
purpose: Clamp bay; carry recovery load to AV-303

name: Electronics sled
dimensions: 52 × 3 × 140, 2 rod sleeves ⌀7.5/⌀4.4, 10 M2.5 insert bosses (25 mm pitch), switch tower 20 high, 2 M3 cage inserts, zip slots
assembly: Modules on M2.5 nylon standoffs

name: Arming switch
material: COTS latching switch (screw or key type)
assembly: Mount to sled bracket aligned with band hole
purpose: Power electronics on the pad only

name: Battery cage + strap
interface: Sled underside, 2× M3 × 16 into AV-306 inserts
assembly: Screw from below; strap through side slots

name: Aft bulkhead face gasket
interface: Coupler aft end face ↔ AV-304 outer disc
assembly: Contact adhesive to AV-304 outer disc
purpose: Keeps ejection gas out of the bay

name: Rod spacers
interface: On AV-305 between bulkheads and sled
assembly: Fwd pair, sled, aft pair, then AV-304 + nuts

name: Forged eyebolt M6
dimensions: M6 shank; RATED working load from maker
assembly: Nut + fender washer inside; threadlock

name: Booster tube
method: Cut; slot with router jig or fine saw + file
dimensions: ⌀66/⌀64 × 600; 4 slots 3.3 × 140 from the tab front, open aft; 2× ⌀4.5 rail-button holes @45°
assembly: Mark slots with printed wrap guide

name: Motor mount tube
dimensions: ⌀31 OD; ID + length PER MOTOR/RETAINER MAKER (placeholder 260)
assembly: Rings bonded while clamped in alignment jig

name: Fin-can core
material: ASA (heat tolerance) — PETG only for ground demo
method: FDM print aft-end down, rails 100 %, rings 70 %
dimensions: ⌀63.7 × 142; bore ⌀31.3; 8 rails 1.6 thick; guide 3.2; tab floors to R20; 4× M3 inserts @R26; rail boss @45°
interface: I-06 fins; bonded to MMT + tube
assembly: Bond to MMT, then slide into tube with fins as alignment keys

name: Forward centering ring
assembly: Bond + fillets both faces

name: Aft fin lock ring
assembly: Removable: unscrew to slide fins out aft

name: Fins
material: 3 mm aircraft birch ply (baseline) / 3.2 mm G10 (upgrade)
method: Laser cut or scroll saw from 1:1 template; edges radiused
assembly: Slide in from aft, lock with BO-405; no glue

name: Motor retainer
assembly: Bond to MMT exactly per maker's instructions; mentor inspection

name: Rail buttons
dimensions: Per maker; must match RANGE rail
assembly: Fwd into BO-409 insert, aft into BO-403 boss

name: Forward rail-button boss
interface: Bonded to tube + BO-404 fwd face
assembly: Epoxy; install insert before bonding

name: Aramid anchor leader
assembly: Wrap MMT between BO-404 and BO-403, bond with epoxy, exit through notch

name: Parachute
interface: Quick link to shock cord loop at 1/3 from AV end
assembly: Z-fold per maker; lines untangled

name: Parachute protector
dimensions: Size per maker for chute + 64 mm tube
interface: Between chute and motor ejection gas
assembly: Burrito wrap

name: Shock cord
assembly: Accordion fold, masking-tape bundles

name: Quick links
assembly: Screw gate closed, check

name: Swivel
assembly: Between chute and cord

name: Certified motor
method: Purchased by / through a certified mentor or club; not designed, modified or stored by students unless the law and the club allow
assembly: Prepared & installed per maker instructions under mentor/RSO supervision

name: Igniter
material: EXTERNAL — supplied / approved by maker, handled by range
assembly: Installed at the pad only, per range procedure

name: Fin alignment jig
assembly: Use during core bonding

name: CG balance cradle
assembly: Balance fully loaded rocket, mark CG

name: Rail fit gauge
assembly: Slide test, no binding
